in_sanskrit.name: Seeni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Purity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Seeni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Seeni is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shuddh' which means pure. It is also associated with the lotus flower, a symbol of purity and spiritual growth. In Tamil and Telugu, Seeni is also the name of a Goddess who is worshipped as the embodiment of purity and grace.
